description: This file defines a helper class 'Log' for logging purposes within an Android project. It provides static methods to log messages at various levels (VERBOSE, DEBUG, INFO, WARN, ERROR, ASSERT) and manages a linked list of LogNode objects to handle log data.

classes.name: Log
classes.description: A helper class that provides static logging methods, acting as a wrapper for Android's native Log class and managing a chain of LogNode objects.

methods.name: getLogNode
methods.description: Returns the current LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setLogNode
methods.description: Sets the LogNode chain to direct logs.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Dispatches log entries to the LogNode chain with specified priority, tag, message, and optional Throwable.

methods.name: v
methods.description: Logs a message at VERBOSE level.

methods.name: d
methods.description: Logs a message at DEBUG level.

methods.name: i
methods.description: Logs a message at INFO level.

methods.name: w
methods.description: Logs a message at WARN level.

methods.name: e
methods.description: Logs a message at ERROR level.

methods.name: wtf
methods.description: Logs a message at ASSERT level.
